Tosafot on Bava Batra 148b:6:1.hebrew: חיישינן שמא יש לו נכסים במקום אחר - ואע"ג דאמרי' לעיל איפכא, להקל: וניחוש דלמא עיוני עיין והדר יהיב? היינו טעמא דמסתבר למימר עיוני עיין, הואיל וכבר חלקם:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 148b:6:1.english: We are concerned that perhaps he has property elsewhere - And even though we said the opposite above, [as a leniency]: "Let us be concerned that perhaps he looked into [his assets] and then gave [the gift]"? This is the reason that it is reasonable to say that he looked into [his assets] — since he had already divided them.
